posts.title: From Mouse to Hex
posts.description: Which hex tile is under the mouse? Turn pixels into fractional cube coordinates, round them, and why rounding all three values on their own gives no hex on a quarter of the area. Plus lines across the grid, to try out.

posts.title: Hex Coordinates
posts.description: Offset, axial, cube and doubled side by side on a hex board. With neighbors, distance as the largest absolute cube difference, and the trap of just counting columns and rows on the offset grid.

posts.title: Blending Noise Layers
posts.description: One fBm looks the same everywhere. Continent, mountains and detail as three layers, four blend modes (add, multiply, mask, lerp) and a number that shows why mountains should only stand where the land is high.
